scope: Internal AI review of a fixed devnet fixture; not an independent human audit or evidence of exploitation
finding: Post-signing simulation sent a valid signed transaction to the RPC provider before preserving its public signature. A provider could broadcast it; a subsequent simulation failure would leave no signature in evidence.

reproduction.environment: Mock RPC and ephemeral local signing only; no network transaction

repair: All simulations send zeroed signatures with sigVerify=false and replaceRecentBlockhash=false. Real signatures are verified locally, retained in memory, and first exposed only by the final send after public-signature evidence is written.

validation.independentCodecComparison: Pinned Solana Foundation @solana/web3.js 3.1.1 generates matching bytes and verifies signatures
